changes.before: There I saw seven stars of heaven bound together, ⟦?⟧ like great mountains, and burning in fire.
changes.after: There I saw seven stars of heaven bound together, ⟦?⟧[a] like great mountains, and burning in fire.

changes.before: Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me and guided me, said to me, “Enoch, whom are you asking about? About whom are you inquiring so eagerly?”
changes.after: Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me and guided me, said to me, “Enoch, whom are you asking about? About whom are you inquiring so eagerly[a]?”

changes.before: These are among the stars that transgressed the command of God. They have been bound here until ten thousand years are completed, ⟦?⟧ of the days of their sin.
changes.after: These are among the stars that transgressed the command of God. They have been bound here until ten thousand years are completed, ⟦?⟧[a] of the days of their sin.

changes.before: From there I went to another place, more terrifying than this, and saw a terrifying sight: a great fire burning and blazing there. The place had a chasm reaching all the way to the abyss, with great pillars of fire descending into it. I could see neither its extent nor its size, nor could I estimate it.
changes.after: From there I went to another place, more terrifying than this, and saw a terrifying sight: a great fire burning and blazing there. The place had a chasm reaching all the way to the abyss, with great pillars of fire descending into it. I could see neither its extent nor its size, nor could I estimate it[a].

changes.before: Then I said, “How terrifying this place is, and how painful to look at!”
changes.after: Then I said, “How terrifying this place is, and how painful to look at[a]!”

changes.before: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “Enoch, why are you so afraid and dismayed?” I answered, “Because of this terrifying place and the sight of painful torment.”
changes.after: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “Enoch, why are you so afraid and dismayed?” I answered[a], “Because of this terrifying place and the sight of painful torment.”
